_comment: Which of mxm-grain-fx's parameters fill the collection's control roles.
Roles come from docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md, which is normative; parameters are named by
their permanent string id, never by display name.
ONE ROLE, DELIBERATELY, AND A PAGE THAT IS NOT HERE YET.
`fx.delay` already existed and this plugin's Mix is the same quantity - how much of the
effect is in what you hear - so it fills the role rather than minting one. That is
mxm-folded-spring's precedent and mxm-bucket-delay's after it.
The seven performed roles this product wants are NOT here, and that is the point.
plans/plan-mxm-grain-fx.md holds page 13 by a ranked policy rather than an inventory, and
fixes the ranking AT THE LISTENING GATE - because the gate can still change which controls
are performed at all. Decision 9 alone decides whether five spray depths become controls or
two do. Roles are permanent once authored, so authoring seven of them against a parameter
set the gate may still move would be minting permanence out of a guess.
So: Mix reuses the role that exists, everything else stays unmapped until the gate, and
page 13 is added to docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md in the same pass that fixes the ranking.
